reviews.title: The WORST customer service and coverage - STAY AWAY
reviews.body:
The WORST customer service. DO NOT USE THEM!
After 13 years with O2 I decided to switch to Lebara. BIGGEST MISTAKE. It's been a month since the switch and there has been nothing but problems:

- My number took several days to transfer over so I had a period of time with NO mobile service (O2 confirmed there was no issue their side)
- I have still no access to the "Primary Line" in my mobile phone. Cannot receive any calls or texts.
- I have spoken to Lebera agents via chat and by phone COUNTLESS times. Each time having to repeat myself and each time having to do the same trouble shooting. NOTHING WORKS
-Finally, after sending an email to complain, I was told to order a new SIM because there must be a problem with my Lebara SIM. So I did, and IT DID NOT ARRIVE.
- I complained and was told it must be "lost" but that a complaint has been raised and I would hear back on the solution. So once again I am waiting, not getting solutions and frankly wasting my time by repeating myself to every agent I speak to.
- Whoever monitors their email is also incompetent - they responded to my email calling me "Jens" and referring to presumably Jens' number. Sounds like a GDPR issue. Then they just stopped responding altogether.

I am super disappointed, frustrated and honestly fed-up by this level of service. This is besides the fact their network coverage is far inferior to O2. 

My advice: spend the extra money and go with a better provider. AVOID LEBARA!

reviews.title: URGENT: VULNERABLE CARER DISCONNECTED AGAIN - SYSTEMATIC MONTHLY CONTRACT BREACHES & COERCION (Ref: CAS-2769234-C8K4D2 / Order ID: G0041102869)
reviews.body: URGENT: VULNERABLE CARER DISCONNECTED AGAIN - SYSTEMATIC MONTHLY CONTRACT BREACHES & COERCION (Ref: CAS-2769234-C8K4D2 / Order ID: G0041102869)Lebara is knowingly endangering a vulnerable customer caring for critically ill parents by repeatedly cutting off vital phone services every single month, ignoring official emails, and dismissing formal complaints.   On 10/09/26, Lebara cancelled my contract yet again. When I called support, Agent Harshal demanded that I make a payment, despite the fact that I already had a £48 credit balance on my account. When I strongly objected and cited Lebara’s written email evidence confirming my credit, Harshal simply put me on hold. This follows an identical incident on 11/08/26, where Agent Urvi falsely demanded payment details, ignored my credit confirmation, and hung up on me, followed by Agent Rosita refusing reactivation and also hanging up.   This forms part of an intolerable, continuous pattern of monthly disconnections and staff hostility:March 2026: Purchased a 50GB Uswitch plan (£3.18/mo). Lebara failed to port my number (07766 137835), sent incorrect SIM hardware, mis-sold me a pricier plan, and three agents (Moin, Rulin, Zeeshaw) hung up on me. Complaints were ignored for a month.   June 2026: Service cut off with no notice. Lebara formally agreed in writing on 12/06/26 to provide a free 6-month 50GB plan to resolve the issue.   July 2026: Service cut off again. Agent Akshay attempted to blackmail me into deleting my truthful Trustpilot reviews under threat of removing my account credit. After I refused to be coerced, my reviews mysteriously vanished, and Lebara re-confirmed a £48 credit balance and 50GB plan scheduled to auto-renew.   August 2026: Contract cancelled again on 11/08/26 despite my remaining credit, with two agents (Urvi, Rosita) abruptly hanging up while I pleaded for service during a family medical emergency.   September 2026: Contract cancelled yet again on 10/09/26. Agent Harshal demanded payment despite my £48 credit and placed me on hold when I challenged him with email proof.   Lebara's actions violate the UK Consumer Rights Act and Ofcom's General Conditions on Customer Vulnerability.   REQUIRED IMMEDIATE ACTION: Senior management must immediately restore my contract on the agreed terms, ensure my £48 credit is properly applied, stop these monthly disconnections, and issue formal compensation. This entire dossier of emails, calls, and review suppression tactics has been escalated directly to Ofcom and the Communications Ombudsman.

reviews.title: Absolutely appalling customer service
reviews.body:
Absolutely appalling customer service – 6 months and still no replacement SIM

I have spent HOURS and literally DAYS of my time on chats and phone calls with Lebara over the last SIX MONTHS trying to get a simple replacement SIM card.

This is my WORK number, which I lost access to during a house move. It is linked to all of my business and social media accounts with over 100,000 followers, so simply changing my number is not a realistic option.

Every time I contact Lebara, I spend hours explaining the situation again. Complaints have been raised and I have repeatedly been promised that a replacement SIM has been sent.

Then I contact them again because nothing arrives, only to be told IT WAS NEVER SENT.

Six months of this. Six months of promises, complaints, chats and phone calls for something as basic as replacing a SIM card.

I cannot understand how a mobile phone company can make such a simple request so unbelievably difficult. The amount of my time that has been wasted is completely unacceptable.

I would seriously think twice before relying on Lebara for an important or business number. When something goes wrong, my experience of getting it resolved has been absolutely dreadful.

This is ruining my business as i cant take business calls return client calls or do much on social media either send me a sim card or let me port my number to another provider
